primary.aggregation: within-recording paired difference; mean of 3 recordings per speaker; 40 speakers equally weighted
primary.completeness: all120 required for complete primary comparison

interpretation: fixed development corpus reconstruction comparison; not physical-strength calibration, unseen validation, absolute-F0 editing or adoption
carrier: float32(60 * 2 ** ((retained Viterbi state % 488)/120)); all states, no pV gain, no resampling paths or refinement

retention.archive_policy: one original ownerarchive; requiredLibraryflow; no shrink/repack/bypass after failure

runtime_provenance_policy.capture: post-native-stage CPU/platform and mapped .so backing-file identities
runtime_provenance_policy.limits: 512MiB/5s cooperative hashing; no actual FPU state or transient/memory coverage
runtime_provenance_policy.incomplete: preserve separately from science outcome; inline authoritative

model_asset_preflight: All five actual model bytes/SHA required before native and quality stages
prior_study_handling: New study only; no old archive recovery, missing-value filling or result reuse
